name: pcf-toolkit
description: Render a URL column as a real link, on a form and in a view.

scripts.build: npm run build --prefix LinkField && npm run build --prefix LinkColumn
scripts.clean: npm run clean --prefix LinkField && npm run clean --prefix LinkColumn
scripts.rebuild: npm run rebuild --prefix LinkField && npm run rebuild --prefix LinkColumn
scripts.refreshTypes: npm run refreshTypes --prefix LinkField && npm run refreshTypes --prefix LinkColumn
